title: OpenAI upgrades ChatGPT voice, adds two Korean voices
key_facts: OpenAI said Thursday it updated ChatGPT voice using the GPT-Live-1.1 model.
Better intonation and vocal expression in multiple languages, including Korean.
Two new Korean voices: male Hanul and female Haetsal.
During searches it uses varied phrases instead of repeating "checking".
Full duplex design lets users talk while listening and add a question mid-reply.
Rollout is sequential, worldwide, free users included.
quote_evidence: It also added two new voices for Korean users: the male voice "Hanul" and the female voice "Haetsal".
The update will be rolled out sequentially to ChatGPT users worldwide, including South Korea.
why_it_matters_hint: Voice assistants keep getting more natural and more widely available, including to free users.
notes: Another pool item (C01-06) covers GPT-Live-1.1 from the model side; this entry is the product and Korean-voice angle.
